items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: Was that with David Clayton Thomas?

ctx.x: I was expected to get a grasp on them and be ready for the gig. Some of the other guys had sheet music on music stands. I in a lot of situations will put music onto my iPad, so and with this software where it’s for reading music off of an iPad. So I did a lot of listening, looking through the parts.
Was that with David Clayton Thomas?
No. He was not — this was just like around a year ago.
